issues.title: Missing pages return HTTP 200 and homepage HTML
issues.impact: Wrong success responses create a soft-404 risk. A genuine Google soft-404 classification is not confirmed without Search Console.
issues.proposal: Generate a localized static 404.html through the existing generator and remove or narrow the blanket 200 SPA rewrite. There is only one intended public document; fragments do not require a catch-all rewrite. Use Netlify custom-404 handling or an explicitly verified 404 rule.
issues.validation: After a preview deployment, / must return 200; a random path must return 404 before JavaScript and show an appropriate error document; /#projects, real assets, robots and sitemap must still work.

issues.title: Server metadata and React Helmet create duplicate/conflicting head tags
issues.evidence: evidence/browser-evidence.json: homepage has two descriptions and two canonicals; missing-rendered has homepage/error canonicals and index/noindex. scripts/search-content.ts:39-50; src/pages/Index.tsx:32-38; src/pages/NotFound.tsx:20-33
issues.impact: Duplicates on the homepage currently agree; on the error route they disagree. This complicates canonicalization and metadata maintenance; no ranking penalty is claimed.
issues.proposal: Use one metadata owner per rendered field. For Helmet-managed tags, serialize the expected ownership markers in static output or avoid re-inserting identical homepage tags. Ensure error responses have route-appropriate metadata from the server.
issues.validation: Count tags before and after rendering: one canonical, one description, and one appropriate robots directive on each tested route.

issues.title: Education logos are much larger than their displayed size
issues.evidence: evidence/browser-evidence.json: ucsc 500x500/92,158 bytes, mcg 337x337/79,370 bytes; both render at 44x44. src/components/sections/Education.tsx:30
issues.impact: About 167.5 KiB of source PNG logo data for two small graphics, although lazy loading defers their initial mobile requests.
issues.proposal: Create optimized high-density logo variants and reference them through siteConfig.educationLogos. Add a repeatable asset optimization command; preserve transparency and visual quality.
issues.validation: Inspect final dimensions/bytes, verify logos at 1x/2x/3x display density and confirm no layout shift or broken paths.

issues.title: Structured job title differs from the current visible role
issues.evidence: Live JSON-LD and src/config/site.json:6 say Associate Software Engineer; rendered current experience and biography say Software Engineer. scripts/search-content.ts:21
issues.impact: Search engines receive inconsistent professional identity information.
issues.proposal: Confirm the current title, then update the configuration so microdata, JSON-LD and visible facts agree. Also verify that dateCreated is a real publication/profile-creation date.
issues.validation: Compare the confirmed title with Person.jobTitle, ProfilePage microdata and visible experience after generation and deployment.

issues.title: Cold-load performance needs diagnosis, not a field-CWV verdict
issues.evidence: evidence/browser-evidence.json: desktop LCP 4.636 s (hero H2), CLS 0.0123; initial script 403,158 bytes decoded / 122,786 compressed. Main CSS about 65.5 KB. Mobile 2.008 s was warm-cache.
issues.impact: One desktop lab observation suggests loading improvements may help, but location, network and cache strongly affect this result. No INP or field percentile was measured.
issues.proposal: Run repeated cold-cache mobile/desktop Lighthouse tests and inspect Search Console/CrUX. Profile main-bundle work, font delivery, and the deliberate clearing/replacement of static root content before React mounts.
issues.validation: Compare repeated controlled runs and inspect field p75 LCP/INP/CLS when data exists. Do not compare these cold desktop and warm mobile samples as device scores.

issues.title: Large social preview card has no configured image
issues.evidence: evidence/home.html has twitter:card=summary_large_image but no og:image or twitter:image. scripts/search-content.ts:44-50
issues.impact: Social link previews may lack the intended image. This is a sharing improvement, not a demonstrated Google ranking defect.
issues.proposal: Add a share-image path to site.json, validate it in the schema and emit absolute og:image/twitter:image URLs from the generator, with relevant image text in locale data if needed.
issues.validation: Check the deployed image returns an image MIME type and renders in actual social preview tooling.

issues.title: HTTP www requires two permanent redirects
issues.evidence: evidence/http-evidence.json: http://www.rusiru.cc/ -> https://www.rusiru.cc/ -> https://rusiru.cc/ (301 + 301). Other tested variants take one hop.
issues.impact: A small extra request for that variant; canonical consolidation already works.
issues.proposal: If Netlify domain configuration permits, point the HTTP www variant directly at the HTTPS apex.
issues.validation: Recheck all four scheme/host variants with certificate validation enabled; preserve one preferred origin and avoid loops.

limitations: One canonical portfolio HTML document was discovered using an advanced crawler cap of 200. A cap is not a statement that 200 pages exist or were audited.
Supplemental evidence covers ten requested URL/host variants and three browser states: desktop, mobile and one intentional missing URL.
No GSC, Bing, GA4, rankings, backlink, competitor, outreach or AI-visibility account evidence was supplied. Actual index status, selected canonical, clicks, CTR and manual actions remain unknown.
The blog subdomain and outbound destinations were not crawled. The main-host sitemap is correctly limited to its one canonical page; fragments and external blog URLs were not added.

Desktop and mobile browser samples were unthrottled and shared a browser cache. The first desktop sample was cold; mobile was warm. No Lighthouse score, INP measurement or field-CWV pass/fail is reported.
Mobile screenshots show no overflow at 390px; a complete accessibility/device matrix was not performed. Lazy mobile logos were not yet requested at the initial viewport, not broken.

The packaged source scanner reported four heuristic warnings: three in unprocessed index.html and one in the design prototype. Live generated metadata/H1 are present, so those warnings are not promoted to production failures.

The raw packaged checklist labeled all 54 tasks Not tested because its comparisons use integer item numbers while CSV IDs are strings. Raw outputs are retained; this reviewed report and reviewed-audit.csv incorporate independently verified evidence instead.
Codebase proposed_fixes.patch is empty; no safe same-host HTTP upgrades were identified. Application source, configuration and deployment were not changed by this audit.
rollback: No application change to roll back; delete only this audit output directory if the report is no longer wanted.
